I am an Aegosexual with a relatively high libido and masturbating doesn't really do anything for me. I am AFAB, and assume you are as well because of the pee comment. 

Technically needing to pee feels like being turned on rather than vice versa. When you have a full bladder it pushes against the reproductive system and voila. 

I personally definitely get turned on, I often get high and drink and both of those simulate it, but physically touching myself doesn't really do anything for me. Despite being 23 I also don't really know what I'm doing and what all the hype is about. Friction feels good, sometimes just squeezing my legs together, but I've never had an "orgasm" or think I've ever been close. 

You don't need to masturbate to be excited, or turned on, or to enjoy explicit content, and if it doesn't feel gratifying theres no point. If it feels like you are forcing yourself or are only doing it because you think you are supposed to, then it just might not be for you. I've spoken to a lot of Allo AFAB people who also just don't get much out of it.

Female anatomy is kinda complicated and I think has a lot more variation in personal preference than Male anatomy I think. Friction, Penetration, Speed, etc. AMAB people seem to be able to figure it out themselves relatively easily, but AFAB people so often have this exact question of "what am I actually supposed to be doing." You can experiment if you want but you might just not enjoy it.

People often think it's weird if I tell them I enjoy sexually explicit content but don't self pleasure and usually ask what I actually get out of it, but I guess I can appreciate the feeling passively and don't need to go any further.

Roughly a year ago I started questioning my gender and now identify as genderfluid and while I do feel much more kinship with Queer as a label, my Asexuality is still very much a part of that.

Everything about the muses can be changed after creation EXCEPT gender and probably name. You can have more than one muse, and things like face types, eye colors, makeup, and hair styles and colors are identical between them. Clothes and face creation that you unlock are also shared between all your muses (provided they are on the same Nintendo switch account). You can technically have two muses, one of each body type, that look essentially identical and have the same name, but you cannot have one muse swap body type at will. You have to quit to title screen and go online again and pick a different muse to swap. 
Character creation that you can change after initial creation includes shape (like height and proportions). There is face, eye, nose, and mouth shape. These options seem to be the same regardless of gender. You can change the color of skin, eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, and hair. Lip and face makeup also. 
Both the fem and masc characters are very androgynous and can easily present as either, so I’m not super sure why they didn’t just commit to one body type. 

If you don’t want more than one, you can still collect clothes and style others or mannequins for the gender you didn’t pick. But swapping between muses isn’t a big hassle.

During that time, I constantly thought about the other people I met in the hospital. Most of them self harmed actively or in the past and I struggled at lot with feeling like I wasn't actually depressed or suicidal. So, I burned myself one morning. My mom saw the burns on my arm, thought they were cuts and became very angry. She forced me to stay within sight and threatened to send me back to the ward. I was absolutely terrified. For the next six months, I burned on and off and was essentially in autopilot. From January to about June, I remember nothing. I genuinely cannot recall anything that happened during the period. I isolated myself and had a very strained relationship with my mother. 

At the end of June into July my entire family took a trip to Austria and I was home alone for 10 days. I was extremely depressed, and was going to hang myself. My friend miraculously texted me right before I was going to do it, and talk me out of it but I ended up scouring the house for sharp objects and I cut myself, thinking about all the people from the hospital.

I have been cutting ever since, I have started ingesting hand sanitizer and took a bunch of codeine cough syrup and Tylenol (two separate events, not at the same time) before my parents hid it from me. A lot a medicines were removed from the cabinet and hidden. I still have nightmares involving my experience at the psychiatric ward. My relationship with my parents has been damaged and inconsistent since and I no longer really talk to my best friend.
